events.text: The failure is in the relaxation parser, not the generic serializer: it indexes geometry blocks and energy blocks as parallel lists. In cell relaxation, ABACUS may emit a new lattice (and a numbered `STRU_ION…` snapshot) without repeating a coordinate block, so three valid energy/force/stress records collapse to the single initial geometry. I’m replacing that list-counting logic with chronological record assembly and using numbered snapshots as the higher-precision geometry for the following relaxation step.
